rules.headings: Inter, Tracking tight. Use font-medium to font-semibold. Never center align dashboards.
rules.body: Inter, text-sm to text-base, text-gray-300 for readability.
rules.quantitative_data: IBM Plex Mono. MANDATORY for timers, coordinates, monetary values, system IDs, event logs.
rules.labels: Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] with IBM Plex Mono for technical feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton, 1px subtle borders on dark surfaces. Minimal shadow, prioritize stark contrast.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers or floating navs (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). DO NOT use for data cards.
visual_enhancers.map_tiles: Esri World Imagery (Satellite). Must feel like a mission-control tactical display.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-[#121212]), sharp or 4px radius max (rounded-sm), 1px solid border (border-white/10). No soft shadows.
components.tables: Dense, compact rows. Use IBM Plex Mono for data cells (time, coords, IDs). border-collapse style with border-b border-white/5.
components.buttons: Sharp edges or 4px radius. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5. Avoid generic Vercel look.
components.status_chips: Small, rectangular (rounded-sm). Use status_semantics colors. Must include a 1px border and 10% opacity background.
components.timers: Large IBM Plex Mono digits. Use tabular-nums class to prevent shifting during countdowns.

grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6. Use Bento layout for stats and map.
grids_and_layouts.employee_mobile: Mobile-first portrait optimized. Bottom drawer/sheet for session actions over a full-bleed satellite map.
grids_and_layouts.forms: Use Shadcn customized inputs. bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 focus:border-white/30 rounded-sm.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense for data (p-4), generous for layout gaps (gap-6, p-8 on containers).

motion.map_pins: Pulsing animations for live employees. Use a base dot with a ::after element animating scale(0.8 to 2.5) and opacity(0.5 to 0) infinitely.
motion.interactions: Crisp, fast micro-interactions. hover:-translate-y-[1px] on interactive cards. duration-150 ease-out.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 4px to 0) for table rows and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance for text. Status colors must be legible against dark gray/black.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke-width to 1.5 or 2 for crispness.
media.maps: react-leaflet or mapbox-gl. Tile URL for Esri: https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx ONLY. Do NOT use .tsx or .ts files.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Heavily customize Shadcn components to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Force dark mode. Strip radiuses to rounded-sm. Strip box-shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.transparency_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface with content underneath. Always use bg-black/80 or solid.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Add data-testid='...' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major data containers.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Setup React Router for Login, Admin Dashboard, Office Setup, Employee Dashboard (Mobile View), History, Reports, Audit Log, Settings, Profile.
instructions_to_main_agent.pwa: Implement PWA manifest and service worker for installability and offline caching support.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep layouts strictly grid/flex based and left-aligned for data.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states.
Use sonner for toast notifications (dark themed).
Missing components? Build them using Shadcn UI base but styled to the tactical ops-console spec.
All monetary/quantitative readouts stay in IBM Plex Mono to keep the technical instrument feel.
